motion: Being married is a better way to live than being single.

dropped_turns.speaker: CON
dropped_turns.text: Picture a single person offered a new path: they can accept without uprooting a spouse or sacrificing a partner's plans. That freedom proves single life can be the better way.

dropped_turns.speaker: PRO
dropped_turns.text: That freedom matters, but it does not show marriage blocks every new path; partners can decide together. Independence is valuable, yet marriage improves life by making freedom answer to shared care.

turns.text: I agree marriage can offer companionship. But companionship exists outside marriage, and tying the better life to one status ignores people whose independence and wider bonds make them flourish.

turns.speaker: PRO
turns.text: Consider a couple facing a sudden job loss: they plan together, share household tasks, and reassure each other through fear. That dependable teammate proves marriage can make life better.

turns.speaker: CON
turns.text: That example shows two caring people, not that marriage itself causes support. A single person can have dependable teammates too, while keeping choices and living space fully their own.

turns.speaker: PRO
turns.text: When two people want to build a home and raise children together, marriage gives their promises a clear structure. That structure makes cooperation easier, so marriage is better in that shared-life case.

turns.speaker: CON
turns.text: People also argue about ceremonies, rings, and family expectations, which can distract from real relationships. But beneath those customs, single life remains better because it lets people define commitment for themselves.

turns.speaker: PRO
turns.text: Marriage is not merely useful for parents or homeowners; it can deepen any loving partnership through shared responsibility. People generally live better when devotion is practiced daily, and marriage gives devotion durable form.

turns.speaker: CON
turns.text: No adult should ever marry. A better life must remain open to changing needs, and marriage encourages people to treat one permanent arrangement as the answer for everyone.

turns.speaker: PRO
turns.text: A married pair caring for a sick parent can alternate errands, meals, and difficult conversations, so neither carries every worry alone. That shared duty proves marriage offers a stronger daily life.

turns.speaker: CON

turns.text: You said no adult should ever marry, but you see it as this adult should marry.

turns.speaker: CON

turns.text: This choice turns on what makes a life stronger when ordinary burdens arrive.
